name: Google Calendar
description: Read and write Google Calendar events via the official Google APIs.

auth.description: Authentication strategy. Provide either an OAuth2 refresh-token block or a service-account block.

mode.description: Auth mode. Defaults to 'oauth2' when a refreshToken is provided.

redirectUri.description: OAuth2 redirect URI used when the refresh token was minted. Defaults to 'urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob'.

serviceAccountKey.description: Service-account JSON (object or stringified JSON). Used when mode='service-account'.

subject.description: Optional user email to impersonate (domain-wide delegation, service-account mode only).

scopes.description: Override the default scope list. Defaults to https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.

defaultCalendarId.description: Calendar ID to use when a tool call omits one. Defaults to 'primary'.
